title: Product Launch: Bravecto Quantum!
description:
Dear Pet Parents,

We are excited to announce that we are now offering Bravecto
Quantum®, a new long-acting flea and tick preventative that
provides up to 12 months of protection with a single injection!

Bravecto Quantum contains the same active ingredient found in
oral Bravecto (fluralaner), but utilizes advanced
extended-release technology to gradually deliver medication over
time. Think of it like a microscopic deck of cards, where a small
layer of medication is released each week to provide continuous
protection throughout the year.

Benefits of Bravecto Quantum include:

• One injection provides 12 months of protection against fleas
and most tick species.
• Eliminates the need to remember monthly or quarterly doses.
• Uses a lower overall dose of fluralaner than oral Bravecto due
to its extended-release technology.
• Provides convenient, veterinarian-administered protection for
an entire year!

A few important things to know:

• Bravecto Quantum may take up to 48 hours to begin working,
which is slower than oral Bravecto.
• The product label includes an 8-month claim for protection
against Lone Star ticks based on laboratory studies. However,
field experience and manufacturer support indicate strong
performance for year-round prevention.
• As with all isoxazoline medications, use with caution in dogs
with a history of seizures or neurologic disorders.
• Safety has not yet been established in breeding, pregnant, or
lactating dogs.

title: Reservation Reminder for East Potomac Golf Links - BLUE Course
description: 96 Confirmation# 424436469 Hi Esther Scott , Your reservation is tomorrow at 8:40 am. East Potomac Golf Links - BLUE Course Saturday, June 20, 2026 8:40 am 1 Player(s) A Note from National Links Trust: We are devastated to share that the Trump administration has terminated National Links Trust’s lease, effective immediately. In the short term, NLT has agreed to stay on as operators, allowing our courses to remain open and our hundreds of dedicated employees to stay in place. However, the future of affordable, accessible, high-quality public golf in the District is bleak. This is not the update we wanted to share. As a DC golfer, you know how special the East Potomac, Langston, and Rock Creek courses are. While this termination is a major setback, we remain stubbornly hopeful that a path forward can be found that preserves affordable and accessible public golf in the nation’s capital for generations to come. PlayDCgolf and NLT remain fully committed to honoring the legacies and principles of DC’s historic public courses. We hope that you stand with us and continue to share your love of DC public golf with friends, family, and beyond. Tee Time Cancellation Policy: Please log into the tee time booking portal at least 2 hours in advance to cancel or reduce the number of players to your tee time. Questions about your reservation? Call us at (202) 554-7660. Book Next Round Visit Our Website East Potomac Golf Links - BLUE Course 972 Ohio Dr. SW, Washington, DC 20024, US (202) 554-76
